column1: # Scenario lines for scene 30010101 (Maze 'Portal' tutorial episode)

column2: The Maze entrance――the “Portal”.<LF>Seeing it like this again, it's a huge place.
Of course it is! After all, an MG passes through here～!
What are you doing in a place like this,<LF>%usernameusernameuserna%-san.
You can't enter the Maze in the flesh, you know.
I know. I still barely know anything about this academy,<LF>so I'm looking around the place.
Everyone heads into Maze Exploration from here, right...<LF>to get Tatsumiya Ore.
The more you dig, the more the students rake in～!<LF>The more you hand over to the academy, the bigger your rewards!
That said, the assigned areas are fixed, so it's not as if<LF>you can dig as much as you like.
And even inside your assigned area, how far you can go ties directly to the team's――<LF>especially to the skill of whoever commands it.
From commanding battles to choosing exploration routes,<LF>every single decision affects the whole team.
I will take my leave here, then. I look forward to you continuing<LF>to fulfill your role as an instructing commander.
